decisions.reason: Still an adjacent dumper variant that reuses the firm's core engineering, sales and service base, and without clear negative market evidence the option is cheap to keep open.
After another year demand should be clearer, but this articulated construction dumper remains close to the core offering and the growing market argues against an early withdrawal.
As a telescopic-loader line with several models, it signals a broader platform commitment and shared capabilities that make abandonment relatively unlikely.
The reported large order and strong rental popularity are direct positive signals, so this close-to-core material-lift line has high value and little reason to be dropped now.
Although it is farther from the established range and still carries more uncertainty, the strong early operating record suggests enough promise to continue rather than abandon.
